title: Kicked Korean Ukrainian Paccheri Pasta
description: A salty, chewy, pescatarian-friendly Ukrainian dish featuring paccheri pasta and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a date-night dinner
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the paccheri pasta according to package instructions until al dente
While the pasta cooks, heat the gochujang sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat, whisking until smooth
Add the minced garlic to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Stir in the ferment-kimchi and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until heated through
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the saucepan, tossing to coat with the kimchi sauce
Flake the smoked salmon into small pieces and add it to the pasta, tossing to combine
Transfer the pasta mixture to the dolsot-stone-bowl and top with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds
Serve immediately, garnished with additional kimchi and green onions if desired
